status: Exploratory extension after initial renewal results and after reading replication papers and workbook layout; not preregistration.
aim: Recompute all supplied per-assay choice indices from raw counts; summarize by trial and generation without excluding outliers. Compare supplied row counts with published counts; retain exact reversed count-sequence reuse observed during layout inspection. Do not pool laboratories, impute missing exclusion flags, infer cell-to-choice calibration or claim this resolves replication disagreements.
analyses: per-assay index recomputation and supplied rounding checks
descriptive trial/generation summaries and trial-matched group contrasts
